class.name: PorchlightGuide
class.brief_description: Provides welcoming and encouraging Porchlight Engine messages.
class.description: A lightweight helper for presenting Porchlight Engine identity, welcome text, and milestone celebration messages. PorchlightGuide does not save or modify player progress. Use [PorchlightProgress] when milestone state must be recorded persistently.

method.name: celebrate_progress
method.description: Returns an encouraging message celebrating the supplied [param milestone]. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed from the milestone name. If the resulting name is empty, returns [code]Every step counts.[/code].

method.name: get_engine_name
method.description: Returns the engine display name [code]Porchlight Engine[/code].

method.name: get_welcome_message
method.description: Returns the default Porchlight welcome message: [code]Take your time. Every step counts.[/code]
